title: ImmerseMON [Cobblemon]
description: This project bridges the gap between high-stakes survival and an immersive cobblemon experience.Whether you are playing fully determined to the pokemon aspect of cobblemon or as a master of the forge, utilizing unique ores and custom weaponry!
body:
This project bridges the gap between survival minecraft and the thrill of journeying alongside your favorite Pokémon.It transforms the standard Minecraft world into a professional-grade RPG experience where you aren't just a player,but a legend in the making.You can choose to play fully determined to the Cobblemon journey—scouring the wilds to find and bond with rare Pokémon or as a master of the forge,utilizing custom weaponry and unique ores to conquer the world’s toughest biomes.

Whether you are a competitive strategist or a technical survivalist,this modpack ensures that every playstyle is deeply enhanced through a curated selection of performance and feature-rich mods.

We want you to play your way.If you prefer a different setup, you can re-enable disabled mods within the pack settings—just remember to swap them out for their current alternatives to avoid crashes.To keep your journey silky-smooth,we’ve packed in numerous performance-enhancing refinements that optimize rendering and keep your FPS high during intense pokemon battles.

Whether you’re here to become the world’s greatest Trainer or a legendary master of the forge,this modpack is built to make every moment of your journey feel rewarding.From the peaceful thrill of discovering a rare pokemon in the wild to the satisfaction of crafting high-tier gear from the ores you’ve unearthed,the choice of how to play is entirely yours.We’ve put a lot of heart into balancing the technical performance with an immersive,living world so that you can focus on what matters most: the adventure.

The modpack have the following mods:

🛠️ Core Mods & Gameplay
Accessories 💍: A mod that adds a system for players to wear extra vanity or functional items like rings and capes.  

Advancement Plaques 🏆: Replaces the standard advancement pop-ups with stylish, glowing plaques at the top of the screen.  

AppleSkin 🍎: Provides helpful visual cues about food, such as how much hunger and saturation a specific item will restore.  

Alloy Forgery ⚒️: Adds a multi-block forge used for smelting alloys, often used for advanced gear.  

Chef's Delight 🍳: An addon for Farmer's Delight that integrates cooking mechanics with other mods.  

Better Third Person 👤: Improves the third-person camera by allowing 360-degree rotation without changing the direction your character is facing.  

👾 Cobblemon (Pokémon) Integration
Cobblemon ◓: The primary mod that adds Pokémon to the Minecraft world with a focus on capturing, battling, and training.  

Cobblemon Additions ➕: Expands the base mod with extra features or specific Pokémon behaviors.  

Cobblemon Extended Battle UI ⚔️: Enhancements to the user interface during Pokémon battles for better visibility and control.  

Cobblemon Research Tasks 📝: Adds objectives and tasks for players to complete, rewarding them for exploring and interacting with Pokémon.  

Cobblemon Size Variation 📏: Makes Pokémon appear in different sizes (e.g., tiny or giant) rather than all being identical.  

Cobblemon Snap 📸: Likely adds photography mechanics similar to the Pokémon Snap games.  

CobbleNav 🧭: A navigation tool or minimap integration specifically for finding Pokémon or points of interest.  

Cobbreeding 🥚: Adds breeding mechanics so players can raise new Pokémon from eggs.  

CobbleDollars 💵: An economy system specifically for the Cobblemon environment, allowing for shops and banking.  

🎬 Camera & Visual Effects
Camera Overhaul 🎥: Enhances the player's camera movement by adding subtle leaning and tilting during motion.  

Camerapture 📷: A tool for taking high-quality in-game screenshots or "captures".  

Cave Dust 🌫️: Adds atmospheric dust particles to caves to make them feel more immersive.  

Biome Particle Weather ⛈️: Introduces unique particle effects like falling leaves or sandstorms depending on the biome.  

Continuity 🪵: Enables "connected textures," allowing blocks like glass or bookshelves to blend together seamlessly.  

⚙️ Utilities & Technical CreativeCore 🧠: A library mod required for several other mods (like Camera Overhaul) to function.  

AzureLib 📚: A technical animation library used by developers to make mobs and items move smoothly.  

CIT Resewn 👕: Allows for Custom Item Textures (CIT) used in resource packs without needing OptiFine.  

Capture XP 🍬: Likely modifies how experience is gained, specifically when capturing Pokémon.  

Catch Rate Display 📈: Shows the numerical chance of successfully catching a Pokémon.  

Custom Splash Screen 🖥️: Allows for a personalized loading screen when the game starts.


We can’t wait to see the teams you build and the legacy you forge. Have a blast exploring the Cobblemon World!
